name: Never Give Up!! ~Yoru wa Three Count Torare Makuri~
original_name: ネバーギブアップ!! ～夜はスリーカウント取られまくり～
source:
“Makiko,” a 20-year-old trainee, joined a dojo to fulfill her long-cherished dream of becoming a female professional wrestler.

What awaited her was training that was even more grueling than she had imagined, along with a strict hierarchy among her strong-willed seniors.

Even as she feels on the verge of giving up, Makiko keeps getting back up time and time again.
She continues to pour out sweat and tears in pursuit of her dream of making her debut !

This is the story of that girl.
